# Adopt Python example

Python tree with an `app` package, a stdlib-only `solo` directory, and a `tests/` directory.

```sh
bazel run //:dx -- init //python/tests/fixtures/adopt-python/...
bazel run //:dx -- generate //python/tests/fixtures/adopt-python/...
bazel build //python/tests/fixtures/adopt-python/...
bazel test //python/tests/fixtures/adopt-python/...
```

All 4 tests pass (`handlers_test`, `pure_test`, `pure_unittest_test`, `login_test`).
